title: Bear and Serpent Dream
description: A large wooden bear head with multiple circular holes dominates the surreal scene, dripping purple and blue liquid from its eyes and snout. A white serpent emerges from its mouth, biting a small blue teddy bear held by a yellow figure with red hair, while rows of identical girls in white and purple dresses stand in a graveyard below under a melting blue sky.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant wooden bear head floating in a black and blue melting sky, the bear has many round holes with blue liquid dripping from its eyes and snout, a white serpent emerges from its mouth biting a small blue teddy bear, a yellow figure with red curly hair stands beside it, below them is a green field with rows of identical girls in white and purple dresses standing among gravestones and flowers, dripping icicles and floating heart symbols in the sky, vibrant yet dark whimsical style
